If you’re looking for **smart lock installation in Kensington, NSW**, these locksmiths service the area and can help with supply, fitting, replacement, and keyless entry setups. [lostkeylocksmiths.com.au](https://lostkeylocksmiths.com.au/locksmith-sydney-east/kensington?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### Smart lock installers near Kensington

- Kingsford Locksmiths & Security — nearby in Kingsford; offers locksmith and security services.   
- Lost Key Locksmiths — Waterloo-based mobile locksmith servicing nearby eastern suburbs; smart lock installation is among their services. [lostkeylocksmiths.com.au](https://lostkeylocksmiths.com.au/locksmith-sydney-east/kensington?utm_source=chatgpt.com)  
- WB Locksmiths & Security — Bondi Beach-based locksmith servicing Sydney’s eastern suburbs.   
- Allen locksmith Sydney — Zetland-based locksmith offering mobile services.   
- Smart Locksmith — Sydney locksmith service specialising in smart/security locks.   

When booking, ask whether they install your preferred type:
- **deadbolt smart locks**
- **mortice smart locks**
- **retrofit smart locks** (keeps your existing lock body)
- **fingerprint/keypad locks**
- **Wi-Fi/app-controlled locks** [balmainlocksmith.com.au](https://balmainlocksmith.com.au/smart-lock-installation/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

If you tell me whether it’s a **house, apartment, or office door** (and your preferred brand, e.g. Yale, Samsung, Lockly, Aqara, etc.), I can narrow down the best installer option.
